influencer.name: Dolmar & Keisha Cross
influencer.description:
Dolmar Cross | Real Estate Investor | Entrepreneur | TV Host

Dolmar Cross went from hustling part-time gigs to flipping over 1,000 properties, turning a bold move at 20—using a student loan to start his real estate business—into a thriving career. Now a top player in Tampa’s market, he specializes in everything from single-family homes to waterfront estates.

As the host of A&E’s reality series Zombie House Flipping and founder of Real Advisors, Dolmar has helped thousands achieve financial freedom. His company has been recognized on Inc. Magazine’s fastest-growing private companies list for four years running. A devoted husband and father of three, he’s building more than wealth—he’s creating a lasting legacy.

influencer.name: Will Adams (DJ JustWill)
influencer.description:
Will Adams (DJ JustWill) – DJ | Performer | Choreographer

DJ JustWill is a powerhouse entertainer with a career spanning music, dance, and creative direction. He’s worked with legends like Madonna, Usher, and the Black Eyed Peas, while also leading campaigns for brands like Mercedes, Nike, and Hennessy.

His DJ performances and music credits include the NBA, NFL, Step Up 6, World of Dance, and So You Think You Can Dance. From the Grammys to the iHeart Music Awards, JustWill knows how to energize any crowd.

Born into a DJ family, music is in his DNA. His passion? Creating unforgettable experiences through sound and movement.

influencer.name: Eduar & Gaby

Meet Eduar & Gaby: A Dynamic Duo

Eduar and Gaby, both in their late twenties, bring passion and drive to everything they do. Gaby, originally from Los Angeles, and Eduar, with roots in Cuba, first crossed paths at a company convention, sparking both a professional and personal journey together. As Senior Vice Presidents at Primerica, they have a combined 16 years of industry expertise, having launched their careers straight out of high school.

Over the past three years, their relationship has flourished, and they are now proud parents to a beautiful baby boy, with dreams of growing their family. In their downtime, Eduar and Gaby love discovering new restaurants, traveling to exciting destinations, and savoring every moment with their son and loved ones.
